### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via DatasetMeasureSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageTabsProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `367b1a38d516f1d2d610ce5abc8c9a44e322d233` — the merge of head `724aeda4e3bf2ea117880eede95757c910d18616` into base `111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 367b1a38d516f1d2d610ce5abc8c9a44e322d233 && git checkout 367b1a38d516f1d2d610ce5abc8c9a44e322d233
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d 724aeda4e3bf2ea117880eede95757c910d18616 && git checkout -B drift-repro 111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d && git merge --no-ff 724aeda4e3bf2ea117880eede95757c910d18616

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 111ffff55603f0f9994f6d6a4a43cb1f60580f3d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

The dev's and the seat's conclusions were read for what they assert and not adopted; every reading below was re-taken from the trees, the diff and the check-runs. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. The pin and its gate — hold.** `.objectui-sha` reads `9646e2ed2bf315a6ae99b2a1633bc7c7d162f7b9`, nothing else. In the scratch clone `git merge-base --is-ancestor 088e0f705520 9646e2ed2bf3` exits 0, `9646e2ed2` is itself an ancestor of objectui `main` (`6c437b07e` at read time), and `git log 088e0f705520..9646e2ed2bf3` is exactly the nine commits the body lists, all squashes, nothing on a side branch: `b0c5f9ddf` (#12177), `5b20aed39` (#12181), `35a2b59a5` (#12180), `7e30d0b6e` (#12182), `d928c8394` (#12185, committed 05:18Z, two hours after `088e0f705`'s 03:19Z, as the dispatch says), `0f31c3a03` (#12186), `26b0bd2d1` (#12189), `5dd583f5e` (#12199), `9646e2ed2` (#12193). The hop is 64 paths (+2431 / −384), 14 of them `.changeset/*.md`. `Console Pin Gate` on this head is `success` (run 38234669497, job 114762401765); it did not skip, because the diff moves `.objectui-sha` and the `filter` job's `console` output is not `false`.

**2. The SDUI artefacts — hold; no parser port is owed.** `sdui.manifest.json` is not in the diff; `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` keeps `sha256` `a799c55a18d6…` and `components: 107` on both sides and changes only `objectuiSha` and `modulesRoot`, so the manifest the generator wrote from the tree built at `9646e2ed2` is byte-identical to `main`'s (107 components), as the body says. That is consistent with the hop: each of its fourteen changesets says the package entry gains no export, prop, type member or input, and the four `minor` ones rename TypeScript names only. `check-sdui-manifest` (record = artefact = pin) and `check:sdui-lockstep` run in `Lint & Repo Gates` (see 6). Lockstep: objectui's `packages/sdui-parser/src` DID change on this hop — four files, +24 / −14, all in `35a2b59a5` (objectui#12180): `SchemaNode` → `ParsedSchemaNode` at `parse.ts:7`, `:17`, `:127`, `:206-207`, `types.ts:4-24`, `validate.ts:27`, `:228` and `body-dialect.ts:36`, `:52`, a type rename and its docblock, no grammar and no code. Re-taken against the record: the delimiter `/* ---------------------- the JS literal subset (#6614) ---------------------- */` sits at `parse.ts:392` of 605 at both pins, the region from it to end of file is 214 lines, a `diff` of the two regions is empty, and `git hash-object` of the region at `9646e2ed2` is `0131f27cf86d…`, the record's `grammarRegion.blob`. Each of the 25 recorded diagnostic codes occurs the same number of times at both pins, and the hop adds no code (the whole `src` diff is the rename). The containment predicate's three lines are identical at both pins: `validate.ts:39` `export const CHILD_LIST_KEY = 'children';`, `:63` `export function acceptsChildren(…)`, `:341` `if (node.children?.length && !acceptsChildren(comp))` — the record's `containmentPredicate.text`. `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` changes exactly `rev`, `revDate` (`2026-10-12T08:01:27+00:00`, the committer date of `9646e2ed2`) and `recordedAgainstPin`; `grammarRegion`, `diagnosticCodes` and `containmentPredicate` are byte-identical to `main`'s.

**3. The spec source edits — comments and strings only; no accept-set change.** A mechanical filter over the diff (every `+` / `−` line under `packages/spec/src` that does not begin as a comment line or as a `+ '…'` string fragment) leaves exactly two lines: the old and new `FormField.span` describe in `view.zod.ts:3560`, which differ in the pin sha alone. `component.zod.ts` (+113 / −21), `action.zod.ts`, `dataset.zod.ts` (+3 each) and `functional-completeness.ts` (+32 / −4) change comment lines only; the six `18.*` migration entries change `rationale` string fragments only (the pin sha, the corpus count 8519 → 8540 and the lit controls). No key, default, `.optional()`, required flag, enum member or export moves; nothing is tombstoned. `Clause-②: no` and the `patch` level are right in kind; the content of the comments is judged in 4.

**7. The base.** The merge base is `74c4b3435e` (#22967's merge). `origin/main` has moved two commits since (`147a0d1acc` #22931, `6a7eca6868` #22936); neither touches a path in this PR, `088e0f705` survives on `main` only in the files this PR moves and in the previous hop's two historical changesets, and `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main FETCH_HEAD` is clean.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/console-9646e2ed2bf3.md`, `@objectstack/console` **minor**: the highest level objectui declared over the range (`LEVEL_RANK` in `objectui-changeset-digest.mjs`: `6349-batch12-components`, `6349-batch12-types`, `6349-batch11-fields` and `6349-batch11-sdui-parser` are `minor`, the other nine `patch`), the level #22967 used, under `pre.json` `mode: pre`, `tag: next`. Its header reproduces from the log: 14 changesets added across the nine commits, `12176-ratchet-field-namespace.md` has an empty frontmatter (release-nothing, from `0f31c3a03`), `7e30d0b6e` adds none, so "13 releasing of 14" and the one `(no changeset)` subject are exact; each of the 13 entries is the opening sentence of the changeset it names, truncated, and each names the commit that added it.
